Credits & saves

This browser arena runs Kaizo Roaring Knight v2.3.3 with its original combat code. The entry point skips directly to the Knight, and the battle result stays in the arena.

  • DELTARUNE: Toby Fox and the DELTARUNE team.
  • Kaizo Roaring Knight: EnderCat8.
  • Browser runtime reference: technonyte00 / DELTARUNE web port.
  • Game-data tooling: UndertaleModTool.
  • Knight-only experience inspired by DEVICE_KNIGHT.

The two routes

Normal Route uses the installed mod’s Chapter 3 second-slot save. Weird Route uses a community save shared in this save request. The Weird Route save has flag 456 enabled, Snowgrave progression 20, and the Knight checkpoint (room 30108, plot 320). The mod itself reads flag 456 to select its harder fight.

Weird Route uses Kris, Susie, and Noelle, with the same battle items as Normal Route. Route progression and character equipment are preserved.

Download the Weird Route save

Your installed game and PC saves are unchanged. Each browser attempt starts at full health from its route’s supplied save. Browser game data stays separate from your PC saves.

Controls

Arrow keys: move/select. Z or Enter: confirm. X or Shift: cancel/slow. C: menu. R: restart this route. Escape: route selection. Use a desktop browser and keyboard.

Source

GitHub source and build instructions. The source repository contains the browser interface and arena patch. Game assets and the GameMaker runtime are separate inputs.
